_readme: CustomerOps (COPS-07) alert definitions for GCP Cloud Logging and Cloud Monitoring. These GCP versions replace the earlier Datadog log monitors (Aditya, 2026-10-14: Datadog is not used; the Datadog definitions are in git history). The four alerts read the structured lines that reportPlatformOpsMetrics writes every 10 minutes from the cops-onboarding-evaluator worker (fields: module, msg, env, cops_metric, value, metric_status, runbook). Not created yet: create them once log shipping to Cloud Logging is in place, and check the field paths (jsonPayload.*) and the env value against a real log entry first. `log_based_metrics` are bodies for POST https://logging.googleapis.com/v2/projects/PROJECT/metrics; `alert_policies` are bodies for POST https://monitoring.googleapis.com/v3/projects/PROJECT/alertPolicies; `notification_channel` is the body for POST https://monitoring.googleapis.com/v3/projects/PROJECT/notificationChannels, and its name goes into each policy's notificationChannels. Setup: docs/ops/cops-alerts.md.
_staging_note: Payment links made in the Razorpay dashboard for testing match no payment request, so payment_webhooks_rejected_24h goes to warn on staging without a real fault. The critical and warning filters leave that metric out on staging (env=staging); everywhere else it alerts as usual.

log_based_metrics.name: cops_metric_warning
log_based_metrics.description: One count per CustomerOps health metric reported at warning, labelled by metric.

log_based_metrics.name: cops_health_report
log_based_metrics.description: One count per CustomerOps health report (the outbox lag line is written on every report).

log_based_metrics.name: cops_health_report_failed
log_based_metrics.description: One count per CustomerOps health report that failed to run.
log_based_metrics.filter: jsonPayload.module="cops-onboarding-evaluator.worker" AND jsonPayload.msg="cops ops metrics report failed"

alert_policies.displayName: [CustomerOps] A workflow health metric is critical

documentation.content: A CustomerOps health metric (${log.extracted_label.cops_metric}) is critical. The runbook path is in the log line's runbook field; thresholds are in docs/ops/cops-alerts.md. Live values: CustomerOps admin > Operations.

alert_policies.displayName: [CustomerOps] A workflow health metric has stayed in warning

conditions.displayName: Warning on three reports in 30 minutes

documentation.content: A CustomerOps health metric has been at warning for 30 minutes. See docs/ops/cops-alerts.md.
No CustomerOps health report for 30 minutes. The cops-onboarding-evaluator worker, Redis or the database is down, so the other CustomerOps alerts are blind. See docs/runbooks/cops-platform.md.

alert_policies.displayName: [CustomerOps] The health report itself is failing

conditions.displayName: The report failed more than once in 30 minutes

documentation.content: The CustomerOps health report fails to run (log message "cops ops metrics report failed"). The worker runs but cannot read the numbers; the error is in the log line.
